name: INRIA Person Dataset
description: The INRIA Person Dataset is a classic computer vision benchmark for pedestrian detection consisting of 2,573 annotated images containing standing and walking upright persons under diverse real-world illumination, orientations, and backgrounds.

license.name: Custom Non-Commercial Research License
license.notes: Distributed by INRIA strictly for non-commercial research and educational evaluations.

source_references.title: Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection
source_references.notes: Seminal CVPR 2005 paper introducing HOG and the dataset.

verification.notes: Verified against CVPR 2005 publication (DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2005.177) and official INRIA distribution. Comprises 1,832 training images (614 positive + 1,218 negative) and 741 test images (288 positive + 453 negative), totaling 2,573 images and 3,542 annotated persons.

size.notes: Images and text bounding box annotations.
